Senses.Explanation: A verb-object phrase: to 'pass completely through' (透) the 'barrier' or 'pass' (關), attested 266 times in 112 allowlisted texts. Huanglong Huinan distinguishes the two conditions: 'one already past the barrier swings his arms and goes straight on' (已過關者掉臂徑去), whereas 'this is one who has not passed the barrier' (此未透關者也). Zhongfeng Mingben records a corrective contrast: people thread all old and new public cases onto one string and call it 'passing the barrier' (謂之透關), while 'the tight barrier of life and death beneath their heels has not actually been passed' (脚跟下一座生死牢關，政好不曾透得). The phrase also builds 'an eye that passes the barrier' (透關眼). Yuanwu Keqin asks whether anyone present has such an eye. Chijue Daochong says, 'Passing the barrier requires a barrier-passing eye; obtaining treasure requires one who can distinguish treasure' (透關須具透關眼，得寶須還別寶人). Poshan Haiming answers the question 'What is a phrase that passes the barrier?' (如何是透關句), and Dabian Xianquan contrasts 'one already through the barrier' (已透關者) with 'one not through the barrier' (未透關者). These are recorded descriptions, corrections, and compounds; this entry adds no unrecorded destination beyond the barrier.
Senses.Note: The attributive forms 'one already through the barrier' and 'one not through the barrier' recur across the corpus. Broader verbs meaning 'get through' or 'pass through' are not counted as headword occurrences unless they are followed by the graph for barrier. Zhongfeng explicitly distinguishes loose passing-through language from passing the tight barrier underfoot; that text-drawn distinction is retained.

Occurrences.Kwic: 已過關者掉臂徑去。安知有關吏。從吏問可否。此未透關者也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Huanglong Huinan, quoted in (續傳燈錄) (Continued Record of the Transmission of the Lamp), says that one already through the barrier goes straight on without asking the gatekeeper.

Occurrences.Kwic: 盡將古今公案一串穿却謂之透關。殊不知脚跟下一座生死牢關。政好不曾透得。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zhongfeng Mingben, in (天目中峰廣錄) (Extensive Record of Zhongfeng at Tianmu), contrasts threading cases together with passing the life-and-death barrier.

Occurrences.Kwic: 莫有具透關眼底。便請出來激揚看。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Yuanwu Keqin, in (圓悟佛果禪師語錄) (Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo), asks whether anyone has an eye that passes the barrier.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所以道：透關須具透關眼，得寶須還別寶人
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Chijue Daochong, in (痴絕道冲禪師語錄) (Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chijue Daochong), says passing the barrier requires a barrier-passing eye.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂，問：「如何是透關句？」師云：「胡笳塞上知音少，羌笛城頭和者稀。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Poshan Haiming, in (破山禪師語錄) (Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Poshan), answers a question about a phrase that passes the barrier.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸仁！莫若一時放卻，已透關者自然七縱八橫，未透關者難免無繩自縛。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dabian Xianquan, in (達變權禪師語錄) (Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dabian Xianquan), contrasts those already through the barrier with those not through it.
